The In Villa Dining Assistant Manager supports the leadership and daily operation of the In Villa Dining department, ensuring the delivery of efficient, personalized and memorable dining experiences within the privacy of the guest villas. The role assists in managing service standards, colleague performance, guest satisfaction, revenue generation and cost control in accordance with Raffles standards and hotel policies.

The position oversees daily In Villa Dining service, including order taking, food and beverage delivery, villa set-up, service recovery, billing accuracy, team scheduling, training and coordination with Culinary, Stewarding, Front Office, Butlers and other hotel departments.
q: Previous experience in a supervisory or assistant management role within Food & Beverage, preferably in a luxury hotel or resort.
Strong operational knowledge of In Villa Dining, room service or other high-end restaurant service operations.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and motivate a multicultural team while maintaining high service standards.
Good understanding of food and beverage service, menu knowledge, food safety, hygiene and guest service recovery.
Sound administrative and commercial awareness, including billing accuracy, cost control, upselling and inventory management.
Excellent communication, organisation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.
Computer literacy and experience with point-of-sale systems; knowledge of Opera or similar hotel systems is an advantage.
Commitment to Raffles service values, discretion, personalised care and continuous improvement.
r: Assist in managing the daily operation of In Villa Dining, ensuring that all orders are received, prepared, delivered and cleared accurately and within established service time standards.
Monitor service flow and colleague deployment throughout the day, adjusting assignments and coverage according to occupancy, business levels and guest requirements.
Ensure that menus, operating procedures, service equipment, order-taking systems and departmental checklists are accurate, current and consistently applied.
Conduct regular operational checks of the order-taking area, service stations, trays, trolleys and other equipment to ensure readiness, cleanliness and proper presentation.
Coordinate closely with Culinary, Stewarding, Front Office, Butlers and other relevant departments to ensure smooth communication and timely fulfilment of guest requests.
Promote a personalized, discreet and anticipatory approach to service, ensuring that guest preferences and special requests are communicated and followed through.
Monitor guest feedback and service performance, handle complaints professionally and ensure appropriate service recovery and follow-up.
Ensure that food and beverage orders are presented according to Raffles standards, including correct table set-up, temperature, portion presentation and requested accompaniments.
Maintain complete knowledge of menus, ingredients, allergens, dietary requirements, promotions and beverage offerings, ensuring that the team can provide accurate recommendations.
Review recurring service issues and recommend improvements to enhance guest satisfaction, efficiency and consistency.
Supervise, coach and support In Villa Dining Supervisors, Captains, Waiters and Order Takers, setting clear expectations and monitoring performance.
Assist with recruitment, induction, departmental training, cross-training and performance feedback in coordination with the department head and People & Culture.
Conduct briefings and communicate daily priorities, VIP arrivals, special occasions, occupancy information, promotions and operational updates.
Ensure colleagues follow grooming, attendance, conduct, hygiene, health and safety requirements and departmental standard operating procedures.
Encourage teamwork, accountability and a positive working environment, recognising strong performance and addressing concerns promptly.
Assist in monitoring departmental revenue, average check, upselling performance, payroll, overtime, breakages and operating expenses against approved targets.
Ensure accurate order posting, billing, payment handling, voids, discounts and corrections in accordance with hotel procedures and delegated authority.
Monitor stock levels and the responsible use of operating supplies, amenities and service equipment; report shortages, losses or damage.
Prepare and review departmental reports, checklists, rosters and other administrative records as required by the department head.
Support menu promotions and revenue initiatives while maintaining guest satisfaction and the positioning of the hotel.

We are looking for a qualified and experienced Environmental/Safety Officer to oversee and implement health, safety, and environmental requirements across project operations. The role involves monitoring workplace safety, ensuring environmental compliance, conducting risk assessments and inspections, and promoting a safe working environment in accordance with applicable HSE standards and regulations.
q: Candidates must meet one of the following qualification and experience criteria:
Bachelor's Degree in an approved Science discipline or Diploma in an approved Engineering discipline from a recognized and reputed university or institution.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience as HSE personnel in the applicable field.
High School qualification with NEBOSH certification from a recognised and reputed institute.
Minimum 10 years of total experience , including at least 7 years of experience as HSE personnel in the relevant field.

Completion of one or more recognised HSE certifications in General Industrial Safety, Construction Safety, Environmental Management, Industrial Hygiene, ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, NEBOSH, ASSP Global Safety Management, or equivalent.
Valid First Aider certification is mandatory.
Must be able to speak, read, and write English.
Academic qualifications must be obtained through full-time or regular part-time programs. Online academic qualifications will not be accepted.
NEBOSH certification is exempted for candidates holding degrees in Safety, Environment, Occupational Health, or Industrial Hygiene fields.
Certificates issued in languages other than English must be accompanied by authorized English translations.
All academic qualifications and professional certifications are subject to verification.
Candidates must strictly meet the specified qualification and experience criteria.
r: Implement and monitor HSE policies, procedures, and site-specific safety requirements.
Conduct regular site inspections, safety audits, and risk assessments to identify potential hazards.
Monitor environmental compliance and ensure effective environmental management practices.
Ensure adherence to applicable safety regulations, environmental standards, and approved HSE plans.
Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings, and HSE awareness sessions for employees and contractors.
Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor workplace activities and ensure appropriate safety measures are implemented.
Maintain HSE records, inspection reports, and environmental documentation.
Coordinate with project teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of HSE requirements.
Promote a strong safety culture and encourage adherence to safe working practices.
